edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Hom. in Cant. I, 5

source_text: Propterea adolescentulae dilexerunt te. Quia per Spiritum sanctum caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris, congrue nomen effusionis inseritur: Unguentum effusum est nomen tuum. Haec dicens sponsa adolescentulas conspicit. Quando illa sponsi patrem rogabat et ad ipsum sponsum cominus loquebatur, necdum adolescentulae aderant; in mediis vero precibus ingreditur iuvenecularum chorus et sponsae laudatur eloquiis. Propterea adolescentulae dilexerunt te. Et attraxerunt te. Adolescentulaeque respondent: Post te in odorem unguentorum tuorum curremus. Quam pulchre sponsae pedissequae necdum habent fiduciam sponsae. Sponsa non post tergum sequitur, sed iuncto ingreditur latere, apprehendit dexteram sponsi et manus eius sponsi dextera continetur; famulae vero ingrediuntur post eum.
pass_a_gloss: On-account-of-this young-women loved you. Because through Holy Spirit love of-God poured in our hearts, fittingly name of-pouring is-inserted: Ointment poured-out is name yours. Saying these bride beholds young-women. While asking father / speaking near bridegroom, young-women not-yet present; mid-prayers chorus enters. Young-women answer: After you into smell of-ointments yours we-will-run. Bride's attendants not-yet have bride's confidence: bride walks joined at-side holding right-hand; servants enter after him.
notes: Pass A literalist gloss ≠ Pass B literary English.
Song lemma sense-checked against Baehrens; Lawson ACW not used for wording.
pass_b_english: Therefore the young women loved you. Because through the Holy Spirit [[the love of God has been poured out in our hearts >> Bible:Romans 5:5]], the name of pouring is fittingly inserted: Your name is ointment poured out. Saying this, the Bride catches sight of the young women. While she was asking the Bridegroom’s Father and speaking close to the Bridegroom himself, the young women were not yet present; but in the midst of the prayers the chorus of young women enters and is praised by the Bride’s words. Therefore the young women loved you. And they drew you. And the young women answer: [[After you we will run into the fragrance of your ointments >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:4]]. How beautifully the Bride’s attendants do not yet have the Bride’s confidence. The Bride does not follow behind; she walks at his side, takes the Bridegroom’s right hand, and her hand is held in the Bridegroom’s right; but the servants come in after him.
